summary: Unchanged primary-only schedules can admit due occurrences after three fresh healthy replication measurements despite continuous in-flight traffic; moved ownership and standby retain strict history gates.

replay.detail: No claim replay or occurrence identity changes; existing catch-up policies remain in force.

schema.detail: No persistent schema, client-v0, generated client or wire format changes.

rules.detail: No retention, checkpoint or projection rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Unchanged primary-only schedules may release nonzero in-flight counts after three distinct fresh comparable measurements with zero invalid records and fenced envelopes; moved ownership and standby still require fresh complete peer measurements.

downtime.detail: No service interruption beyond a normal upgrade.

recovery.detail: Restart resets process-local progress; unhealthy measurements, quiet gaps and inventory or incarnation changes reset the streak. The bounded fallback favors liveness without proving delivery of each old envelope.
